note: The roadmap is this guide's own reading of the official descriptions: story chapters and missions first, then contact strands, activities, exploration, crime, and money. Missable trophies are flagged in the stage where they belong, with the recovery note in each guide.

stages.goal: Finish the story and catch every mission trophy while it is in front of you.
stages.missable_note: The six mission trophies (Trust, Break the Bank, Family Matters, DWNFALL, Hi-Jacked, Snow Storm) belong to single story missions. Play each mission when the story offers it; if one does not pop, replay it from the pause menu's mission replay.
stages.title: Play the story

stages.goal: Clear the five contact strands and any 8 stranger strands, in any order.
stages.title: Finish the contacts

stages.goal: Sample every activity, gold the shooting range, and win the races.
stages.title: Activities and skills

stages.goal: Sweep the map: areas, vehicles, cards, spots, garages and registrations.
stages.title: See all of Leonida

stages.goal: Work the combat and one-off trophies, including the setup-missables.
stages.missable_note: Five of these are missable in setup, not in story: Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Catch Me If You Can, Sneakthief and Capital Offense. Each needs a specific setup — partner beside you, a planned route, a quiet runway, a clean job, a clear run-up. A failed attempt just means setting it up again.
stages.title: Crime spree

stages.goal: Launder the marked bills, spend across the shops, hit 100% — the platinum pops with it.
stages.title: Money and the platinum
